scope: Approved: screens and guest flow first
appearance: Uses saved System, Light or Dark setting. New installs default to System. Screen and alert accents adapt for readable contrast.
guest: Try it first persists kicklab.welcome.completed and opens existing training home. Profile sign-in sheet is dismissible without changing local profile.
providers: Apple uses ASAuthorizationAppleIDButton. Google uses official supplied Google G artwork. Email is a smaller outlined secondary option. All three show an availability notice; no account, email address or credentials are collected or stored.
legal: Terms and Privacy actions show availability notices pending published documents.
presentation: Welcome, Home and their modal destinations share a stable root presentation host.
email: Optional choice on both Welcome and Profile. Guest access remains prominent and available from the notice. Email verification and its entry sheet will be connected in the authentication phase.
